The vets are pretty good but the prices are criminal. Save some money by asking the vet to transfer your pet's prescription to your nearest pharmacy. We saved roughly $70 on pills ($150 at Forest Hill Animal Clinic vs $86 at my local pharmacy). They charge almost double the price. We've taken our three cats here for almost 10 years and the care and compassion they get is second to none.

The kind of people who will make your pet feel like their top priority and while good veterinary care is inherently pricey, they're great about making things as affordable as reasonably possible and they don't nickel and dime you.

Having our pets cared for by this clinic is a great reassurance.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr Klys. He is knowledgeable, thorough and skilled in his field (opthamology) and his bedside manner is amazing. I just wished all veterinarians were like him. The ladies at the front desk are always pleasant to deal with.

We had an excellent experience with Forest Hill Animal Clinic during our recent ophthalmology visit with our dog, Turbo. We came in dealing with a serious and stressful eye condition, and Dr. Richard Klys was thorough, knowledgeable, and very clear in explaining what was happening with Turbo’s eye, the treatment options, and what we should expect going forward.

What stood out to us was the level of attention and care throughout the visit. Dr. Klys took Turbo’s condition seriously, performed a comprehensive ophthalmic assessment, and gave us a clear treatment plan to follow at home. Having someone with his experience evaluate Turbo gave us much more confidence in how to manage his condition.

The staff at Forest Hill Animal Clinic were also professional, organized, and helpful throughout the process. When your dog is dealing with something as concerning as an eye problem, having a veterinary team that communicates clearly and treats your pet with care makes a huge difference.

We’re very grateful to Dr. Klys and the entire team for taking care of Turbo and would highly recommend Forest Hill Animal Clinic, particularly to anyone looking for experienced veterinary ophthalmology care.
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We deeply respect your review and are glad to hear about your experience at Forest Hill Animal Clinic.

Our precious baby, Angelo, unfortunately developed an ulcer on his eye after an injury, and we were referred to Dr. Klys at Forest Hill Animal Clinic. From the very beginning, Dr. Klys was incredibly kind and compassionate. He took the time to explain Angelo’s treatment plan in detail and made sure we understood every step.

Angelo is a member of our family, and it means so much to us that Dr. Klys treats him with such gentleness and care. He even calls him “Pumpkin,” which is so sweet! Thanks to his treatment, Angelo has made a huge improvement.

The clinic has also been very accommodating of Angelo’s needs. Because he has severe anxiety around other dogs, which can potentially trigger a seizure, they allow us to bring him in through a separate entrance. This thoughtful accommodation has made his appointments much safer and less stressful.

Dr. Klys is a genuinely down-to-earth person who clearly cares deeply about animals. We are so grateful to him and the entire Forest Hill Animal Clinic team for everything they have done for Angelo. I would highly recommend them to any pet owner!
Always efficient, warm and professional. Dr. Klys is the most caring and professional veterinarian one could possibly want.

I cannot recommend Dr. Khys enough. From the moment we met him, he was incredibly kind, compassionate, and knowledgeable. He took the time to thoroughly examine Mela’s eye, measure her eye pressure, explain exactly what was going on, and ensure every step of her care followed the highest standard.

After months of trying everything to save her eye, he knew exactly what needed to be done and got her into surgery as soon as possible. Throughout the entire process, I felt completely confident that Mela was in the best hands.

Today, Mela had her stitches removed, and she has been doing absolutely amazing. Best of all, she still has her vision. After everything she went through, seeing her happy, comfortable, and able to see again is something our family will never take for granted. Her recovery has been nothing short of incredible, and I truly believe that’s a testament to Dr. Khys’ expertise and the exceptional care she received from him and his team.

Thank you, Dr. Khys and the entire team, for giving my sweet girl the best possible outcome. I will always be grateful for your kindness, skill, and dedication. You made one of the hardest moments for our family so much easier, and we can’t thank you enough.

Our foster fail kitty Kk came to us with eye issues, presumably from feline herpes. Since she was a kitten she was consistently on anti-virals and antibiotics to manage her eye discharge and inflammation . When we finally adopted her we knew there must be a better way and were eternally grateful to have been referred to Dr.Klys practice.

Whole Dr. Klys may not be a board certified ophthalmologist, he is very knowledgeable about eye health and in the first visit, we were able to get off anti-virals and antibiotics right away - managing her condition with eye lubricant eye drops and anti-inflammatory eye drops instead. Kk’s health improved dramatically after stopping these two medications which we believe stunted her growth. Several months later Kk got into an incident and had an eye rupture, thankfully Dr. Klys was able to fit us in for an emergency eye graft surgery and her eye has healed wonderfully. It was a scary situation and we’re grateful for the care of the team ❤️

Very disappointing experience overall. We were initially assigned one vet , then later they told me she was new and had “run out of options,” and our case was passed to another doctor. From the first visit, we were pushed into $500 bloodwork for alleged “muscle loss,” followed by weekly visits with sedation instead of a clear long-term plan.

Medication management felt excessive and forced repeat visits, which added up quickly. Follow-ups were not charged at first, but during the last visit we were suddenly told we would now be charged — that’s when I decided to cancel and move on.

I also asked about using Cytopoint and was told it was too expensive at $370, yet my bill that day was already $270, so the savings didn’t make sense. After spending about $1,500 total, they now wanted to charge consult fees and do more swabs with little improvement.

Disorganized, overly aggressive, and unnecessarily expensive. I won’t be returning.
